extra.description: Longitudinal deep learning models for mammography-based breast cancer risk prediction output either per-year cumulative risks or a discrete distribution over the year of diagnosis, from which cumulative risks F1,...,F5 are derived. These models are evaluated almost exclusively with year-wise AUCs and the concordance index. We show that these metrics are largely insensitive to when cancer occurs: they can be high even for a model that carries no information about the year of diagnosis. We re-evaluate two recent longitudinal models (OA-BreaCR, LMV-Net) on CSAW-CC with a 5-year horizon using timing metrics computed on cancer cases only. Despite C-indices up to 0.75, neither orders cancer cases by time to diagnosis significantly better than chance (c_time 0.51 and 0.55, both 95% CIs covering 0.5). Weighted absolute timing error favours a constant "year 3" prediction over both models, so we use c_time as the primary timing metric. For Mirai's additive-hazard head, also used by LMV-Net, we analyse how per-year increments passed through a ReLU can collapse under severe class imbalance. We also propose a breast-level, two-stage model that separates whether from when. It matches LMV-Net in discrimination (C-index 0.745 vs. 0.746) but orders cancer cases better (c_time 0.58 vs. 0.51, paired 95% CI of the difference 0.01-0.13), on par with Mirai's published weights (0.57).

items.title: HoloGene: Learning to Lift Sliced Spatial Transcriptomics to Holistic 3D Gene Fields
items.title_zh: HoloGene：学习将切片空间转录组学提升为整体3D基因场
items.summary_zh: 空间转录组学（ST）提供空间分辨的基因表达测量，但大多数3D ST数据集作为独立处理的2D切片获取。计算方法涵盖切片配准和整合、显式或生成插值以及坐标场建模。在最后一类中，隐式神经表示（INR）提供连续、可坐标查询的参数化，但标准各向同性坐标编码未明确反映连续切片测量在平面内密集而沿轴向稀疏。我们提出 HoloGene，一个各向异性条件 INR 框架，用于从预配准 ST 切片估计连续3D基因表达场。其核心贡献是一种采集感知的因子分解，使用已建立的 GAE、FiLM、伪标签监督和 CORAL 组件将密集平面内合成与稀疏轴向演化耦合。HoloGene 将高维表达谱压缩为图自编码器潜在流形，使用伪标签衍生的签名条件提供粗略切片内上下文，并应用深度依赖的 FiLM 调制来建模轴向变异。签名分层相关对齐正则化器鼓励潜在特征中的跨切片协方差对齐。使用留出测量切片作为横截面参考，HoloGene 与通用

extra.description: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) provides spatially resolved gene expression measurements, but most 3D ST datasets are acquired as independently processed 2D sections. Computational approaches span slice registration and integration, explicit or generative interpolation, and coordinate-field modeling. Within the last family, implicit neural representations (INRs) offer a continuous, coordinate-queryable parameterization, but standard isotropic coordinate encodings do not explicitly reflect that serial-section measurements are dense in-plane and sparse along the axial direction. We present HoloGene, an anisotropic conditional INR framework for estimating continuous 3D gene-expression fields from pre-registered ST sections. Its central contribution is an acquisition-aware factorization that couples dense in-plane synthesis with sparse axial evolution using established GAE, FiLM, pseudo-label supervision, and CORAL components. HoloGene compresses high-dimensional expression profiles into a graph-autoencoder latent manifold, uses pseudo-label-derived signature conditioning to provide coarse intra-section context, and applies depth-dependent FiLM modulation to model axial variation. A signature-stratified correlation-alignment regularizer encourages cross-slice covariance alignment in latent features. Using held-out measured sections as cross-sectional references, HoloGene improves reconstruction accuracy and biological preservation metrics compared with general-purpose INRs and adapted spatial-transcriptomics baselines. These results support anisotropic conditional modeling as a practical strategy for estimating 3D expression fields from discontinuous ST sections. Code is available at https://github.com/Szym29/HoloGene.

items.title: Dynamic Hierarchical Interleaved Bloom Filter: An Updatable Index for Large-Scale Fast Sequence Search
items.title_zh: 动态分层交错布隆过滤器：用于大规模快速序列搜索的可更新索引
items.summary_zh: 动机：测序成本的持续下降促进了可用测序数据的指数增长，欧洲核苷酸档案（ENA）和序列读取档案（SRA）等公共数据库达到数拍字节量级。这促使开发更可扩展的工具用于常见生物信息学任务。其中一个任务是近似搜索参考数据集中的短序列模式，如基因或 reads。近年来，已提出多种索引数据结构用于搜索大型测序数据库。最先进的索引，分层交错布隆过滤器（HIBF），是首个能够索引一百万个样本的索引。然而，其静态设计需要在存储库增长时进行昂贵的完全重建，促使扩展以支持动态更新。结果：在本文中，我们通过扩展 HIBF 以部分重建来支持高效更新，引入一种可扩展且可更新的序列搜索索引。我们通过从超过100 TB 压缩 reads 跨超过39,000个完整人类 RNA-Seq 样本迭代创建索引，以连续批次100更新，展示了 Dynamic HIBF 的大规模数据能力。为与最先进工具进行基准测试，我们在5,000个样本

extra.description: Motivation: A continued decrease in sequencing costs has facilitated the exponential increase in available sequencing data, with public databases like the European Nucleotide Archive (ENA) and Sequence Read Archive (SRA) reaching well in the order of petabases. This has been the incentive to develop more scalable tools for common bioinformatics tasks. One such task is the approximate searching of short sequence patterns like genes or reads in reference data sets. In recent years, a variety of indexing data structures have been proposed for searching large sequencing databases. The state-of-the-art index, the Hierarchical Interleaved Bloom Filter (HIBF), was first-in-class to index one million samples. However, its static design necessitates costly full reconstructions as repositories grow, motivating an extension to support dynamic updates. Results: In this paper, we introduce a scalable and updatable sequence-search index by extending the HIBF with partial rebuilding to support efficient updates. We demonstrate the Dynamic HIBF's capacity for large-scale data by iteratively creating an index from over 100 TB of compressed reads across more than 39,000 full human RNA-Seq samples, updated in consecutive batches of 100. To benchmark against state-of-the-art tools, we evaluated incremental performance on a subset of 5,000 samples sub-sampled to 1% of their original read depth. In this comparative setting, the dynamic HIBF completed the sequential insertion of all 5,000 samples in 5.3 hours--23 to 42 times faster than competing methods and twice as fast as the static HIBF.

items.title: More Genes, Faster Inference: Efficient Large-Panel Spatial Transcriptomics Prediction from Histology
items.title_zh: 更多基因，更快推理：从组织学高效预测大面板空间转录组
items.summary_zh: 从组织学预测空间转录组（ST）旨在直接从组织图像推断空间分辨的基因表达谱。这是一个具有挑战性的问题，目前通常用复杂的模型架构、额外输入和复杂的训练流程来解决，同时仍局限于固定的小基因面板。这引出一个自然的问题：是否存在一种高效的大面板 ST 预测方法？在此，我们提出 GeneFlow，一个更简单却有效的大规模空间基因表达预测框架，它将流匹配生成建模与结构化多模态融合统一起来。具体而言，GeneFlow 首先通过组织学和基因分词器在空间点上编码组织学形态和跨基因相互作用。该模型直接预测空间基因表达，而非中间速度场，同时以基于速度的流匹配目标进行训练。我们表明，即使不依赖重型生成流程，GeneFlow 在多个 ST 基准上也达到最先进性能，在 1000 基因预测中提升高达 56.8%。大量实验进一步表明，GeneFlow 产生具有生物学意义的点谱，同时将计算成本降低数个数量级，从而提高效率和可

extra.description: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) prediction from histology aims to infer spatially resolved gene expression profiles directly from tissue images. This is a challenging problem that is currently often addressed with complicated model architectures, additional inputs, and complicated training procedures, while remaining limited to fixed, small gene panels. This raises a natural question: Is there an efficient method for large-panel ST prediction? Here, we present GeneFlow, a simpler yet effective framework for large-scale spatial gene expression prediction that unifies flow-matching generative modeling with structured multimodal fusion. Specifically, GeneFlow first encodes both histological morphology and cross-gene interactions in spatial spots through histology and gene tokenizers. The model directly predicts spatial gene expression, rather than an intermediate velocity field, while being trained with a velocity-based flow-matching objective. We show that, even without relying on heavy generative pipelines, GeneFlow achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple ST benchmarks, with up to 56.8% gains in 1,000-gene prediction. Extensive experiments further show that GeneFlow produces biologically meaningful spot profiles while reducing computational cost by orders of magnitude, thereby improving efficiency and scalability, particularly in clinical settings. We believe GeneFlow provides an opportunity for leveraging widely available histology images for downstream biological discovery. Code is available at: https://github.com/ZZhangsm/GeneFlow

items.title: Bridging Graph and Pairwise Learning for Gene Regulatory Network Inference from scRNA-seq Data
items.title_zh: 融合图学习与成对学习，从scRNA-seq数据推断基因调控网络
items.summary_zh: 动机：基因调控网络（GRNs）捕捉转录因子（TFs）调控基因的潜在相互作用。基于基因表达数据，现有GRN推断方法大致分为两类：基于图的方法，将GRN建模为整体图；基于成对的方法，将GRN分解为单个TF-靶基因对进行建模。然而，每种方法都有局限性，而这些局限恰恰是另一方的优势。基于图的方法因依赖单一训练图而容易过拟合，而成对方法则受益于丰富的TF-靶基因训练对。相反，成对方法忽略了全局拓扑结构，而这对全面捕捉调控机制至关重要。结果：为解决这些局限，我们提出scGPL，一个端到端统一框架，联合建模全局调控拓扑和局部相互作用。scGPL从全局调控图中提取宏观特征，并引入动态的、重要性引导的子图采样机制以捕捉细粒度局部依赖。通过融合全局表示与子图增强的局部特征，我们的框架弥合了两种范式之间的差距，既纳入必要的全图拓扑依赖，又保留成对方法的数据丰富优势。在七个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，scGPL持

extra.description: Motivation: Gene regulatory networks (GRNs) capture the underlying interactions through which transcription factors (TFs) regulate genes. Based on gene expression data, existing GRN inference approaches generally fall into two categories: graph-based methods, which model the GRN as a whole graph, and pairwise-based methods, which decompose the GRN into individual TF-target gene pairs for modeling. However, each approach exhibits limitations that are precisely the strengths of its counterpart. Graph-based methods tend to overfit due to their reliance on a single training graph, whereas pairwise-based methods benefit from abundant TF-target training pairs. In contrast, pairwise-based methods overlook the global topological structure, which is essential for comprehensively capturing regulatory mechanisms. Results: To address these limitations, we propose scGPL, an end-to-end unified framework that jointly models global regulatory topology and local interactions. scGPL extracts macro-level features from the global regulatory graph and introduces a dynamic, importance-guided subgraph sampling mechanism to capture fine-grained local dependencies. By fusing global representations with subgraph-enhanced local features, our framework bridges the gap between the two paradigms, incorporating essential whole-graph topological dependencies while retaining the data abundance advantage of pairwise methods. Extensive experiments on seven benchmark datasets demonstrate that scGPL consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance, with up to 13.7% improvement over the strongest baseline, validating the effectiveness of our integrative design. Availability and implementation: The source code is maintained on GitHub (https://github.com/talent-hang/scGPL), and the datasets and versioned releases are archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21608485 for reproducibility.

items.title: Publications as benchmarks: auditing AI agents on spatial transcriptomics alignment
items.title_zh: 出版物作为基准：审计AI智能体在空间转录组对齐上的表现
items.summary_zh: AI智能体正越来越多地自动化数据分析，但负责任的采用需要可靠的性能评估，这在专业科学领域成本高昂。我们引入了一个框架，将科学出版物转化为AI智能体可审计的基准，并展示了其在空间转录组对齐任务上的应用。在121个任务、16个基线方法和六个AI智能体中，最佳智能体（GPT-6-Astra和Gemini-4-Argon）在80%的任务上匹配或优于所有基线，通常使用令人惊讶的简单启发式方法。智能体性能对提示和访问预安装包具有鲁棒性。基准构建还揭示了先前工作中的错误和当前评估指标中的捷径。最后，我们表明智能体生成的解决方案可以蒸馏成一个可重用的程序，在未见数据上排名前10%的基线方法。我们的框架提供了一种可扩展的方式，通过利用和压力测试现有论文和指标来评估专业科学领域中的AI智能体。

extra.description: AI agents are increasingly automating data analysis, but responsible adoption requires reliable performance evaluation, which is costly in specialized scientific domains. We introduce a framework that translates scientific publications into auditable benchmarks for AI agents and demonstrate its use on spatial transcriptomics alignment tasks. Across 121 tasks, 16 baseline methods, and six AI agents, the best agents (GPT-6-Astra and Gemini-4-Argon) matched or outperformed all baselines on 80% of tasks, often using surprisingly simple heuristics. Agent performance was robust to prompting and access to pre-installed packages. Benchmark construction also uncovered errors in prior work and shortcuts in current evaluation metrics. Finally, we show that agent-generated solutions can be distilled into a reusable program that ranks in the top 10% of baseline methods on unseen data. Our framework offers a scalable way to evaluate AI agents in specialized scientific domains by leveraging and stress-testing existing papers and metrics.

items.title: Synchronized Optimal Transport Reconstructs Coupled Transcriptomic and Chromatin Dynamics
items.title_zh: 同步最优传输重建耦合的转录组与染色质动态
items.summary_zh: 跨发育阶段收集的单细胞 RNA 和 ATAC 数据提供了转录和调控状态的时间进程快照。由于测序是破坏性的，这些快照之间的轨迹必须从独立采样的细胞群体中推断。现有方法通常在单一模态中推断连续动态，或在共享表示中整合 RNA 和 ATAC。在此我们提出跨组学对齐轨迹推断（COATI），它将非平衡同步动态最优传输扩展为时间依赖的跨模态映射，以在不同 RNA 和 ATAC 状态空间中重建耦合轨迹。我们在合成基准和四个发育数据集上使用留出阶段重建和谱系分析评估了 COATI。COATI 改善了留出阶段细胞群体的重建，包括恢复细胞类型内的染色质状态异质性，并更好地保留了发育谱系关系。非平衡形式允许推断群体质量变化，这些变化被证明与早期阶段的 DNA 复制程序和发育后期的谱系成熟程序相关。耦合轨迹使得分析发育过程中谱系特异的转录和染色质变化及其时间关系成为可能。COATI 推断的谱系响应与独立的 CRI

extra.description: Single-cell RNA and ATAC data collected across developmental stages provide time-course snapshots of transcriptional and regulatory states. Since sequencing is destructive, trajectories between these snapshots must be inferred from independently sampled cell populations. Existing approaches typically infer continuous dynamics in a single modality or integrate RNA and ATAC in a shared representation. Here we present Cross-Omics Aligned Trajectory Inference (COATI), which extends unbalanced synchronized dynamical optimal transport to time-dependent cross-modal maps for reconstructing coupled trajectories in distinct RNA and ATAC state spaces. We evaluated COATI on synthetic benchmarks and four developmental datasets using held-out-stage reconstruction and lineage analyses. COATI improved reconstruction of cell populations at held-out stages, including recovery of chromatin-state heterogeneity within cell types, and better preserved developmental lineage relationships. The unbalanced formulation allows the inference of population mass changes, which were shown to associate with DNA-replication programs at early stages and lineage-maturation programs later in development. The coupled trajectories enabled analysis of lineage-specific transcriptional and chromatin changes and their temporal relationships during development. Lineage responses inferred by COATI agreed with independent CRISPR perturbation results, and the inferred regulatory patterns were consistent with independent epigenetic data.

items.title: HistoTx: Early fusion of H&E images and spatial transcriptomics at varying spatial transcriptomics resolution with self-supervised learning
items.title_zh: HistoTx：在不同空间转录组学分辨率下，通过自监督学习对H&E图像和空间转录组学进行早期融合
items.summary_zh: 空间转录组学绘制组织切片上的基因表达图谱，当与全切片图像整合时，可联合捕获形态结构和分子活动，从而提供组织生物学的丰富多模态视图。将空间转录组学与WSI结合的ML方法通常通过对比对齐或对病理基础模型进行监督微调，学习从形态特征到分子谱的映射。在这两种情况下，转录组学都作为训练信号而非真正的输入模态，使推理从根本上由图像驱动。我们提出一种早期融合视觉Transformer架构，其中转录组token以任意空间分辨率构建，与图像块token合并，并通过共享Transformer堆栈联合处理，以实现深度跨模态交互。从预训练的纯视觉病理基础模型出发，我们通过在配对的图像和空间转录组学数据上继续自监督预训练来训练HistoTx，并证明：1）在仅使用图像进行推理时，性能在大多数任务上与基线持平，同时在本质上受益于分子知识的任务（如基因表达预测）上有所提升；2）当推理时两种模态均可用时，联合提供图像和转录

extra.description: Spatial transcriptomics maps gene expression across tissue sections and, when integrated with whole slide images, jointly captures both morphological architecture and molecular activity to provide a rich, multimodal view of tissue biology. ML approaches combining spatial transcriptomics and WSIs typically learn a mapping from morphological features to molecular profiles via contrastive alignment or supervised fine-tuning of pathology foundation models. In both cases, transcriptomics serves as a training signal rather than a true input modality, leaving inference fundamentally image-driven. We propose an early-fusion vision transformer architecture in which transcript tokens are constructed at arbitrary spatial resolution, merged with image patch tokens, and jointly processed through a shared transformer stack for deep cross-modal interaction. Starting from a pretrained vision-only pathology foundation model, we train HistoTx by continuing self-supervised pretraining on paired image and spatial transcriptomics data and demonstrate that: 1) at inference with image only, performance remains on par with the baseline on most tasks while improving on tasks that inherently benefit from molecular knowledge, such as gene expression prediction; 2) when both modalities are available at inference, jointly providing image and transcript inputs outperforms either modality alone.

items.title: ST-FateFlow: Continuous Gene-Spatial Reconstruction with Differentiation-Potential Learning from Time-Resolved Spatial Transcriptomics
items.title_zh: ST-FateFlow：从时间分辨空间转录组学通过分化潜能学习进行连续基因-空间重建
items.summary_zh: 时间分辨空间转录组学通过测量细胞状态及其跨时间的空间组织，提供动态生物过程的强大视图。然而，破坏性分析和实验成本将观察限制在从独立样本收集的少数离散时间点，且跨时间没有已知的细胞配对。这使得难以重建未观察阶段的基因表达和组织组织，并表征分化相关动态。在此，我们引入 ST-FateFlow，一个用于连续基因-空间动态和分化潜能学习的流匹配框架。ST-FateFlow 联合学习基因表达和空间坐标速度场，能够插值缺失时间点并连续建模转录演化和组织重塑。同时，它独立学习时间条件分化潜能，其值沿推断的分化进程组织细胞状态，并支持分化相关转录变化的分析。在多个时间分辨空间转录组学数据集中，ST-FateFlow 有效捕捉协调的基因表达和空间动态。案例研究进一步表明，学习的潜能景观与已知发育和再生轨迹一致，并有助于识别与分化进展相关的候选基因。

extra.description: Time-resolved spatial transcriptomics provides a powerful view of dynamic biological processes by measuring cellular states together with their spatial organization across time. However, destructive profiling and experimental cost restrict observations to a few discrete time points collected from independent samples, with no known cell pairing across time. This makes it difficult to reconstruct gene expression and tissue organization at unobserved stages and to characterize differentiation-associated dynamics. Here, we introduce ST-FateFlow, a flow-matching framework for continuous gene-spatial dynamics and differentiation-potential learning. ST-FateFlow jointly learns gene-expression and spatial-coordinate velocity fields, enabling interpolation of missing time points and continuous modeling of transcriptional evolution and tissue remodeling. In parallel, it independently learns a time-conditioned differentiation potential, whose values organize cell states along inferred differentiation progressions and support the analysis of differentiation-associated transcriptional changes. Across multiple time-resolved spatial transcriptomics datasets, ST-FateFlow effectively captures coordinated gene-expression and spatial dynamics. Case studies further show that the learned potential landscapes are consistent with known developmental and regenerative trajectories and help identify candidate genes associated with differentiation progression.

items.title: Weight-Space Programming Changes How an LLM Uses Python for Computational Biology
items.title_zh: 权重空间编程改变LLM在计算生物学中使用Python的方式
items.summary_zh: 权重空间编程允许语言模型无需基于梯度的训练即可编辑另一模型的权重。我们使用Claude Opus 5.5编辑Qwen3.5-0.8B，并研究编辑如何改变其在计算生物学问题上使用Python的方式。我们在三个测试种子的50个测试问题上比较四个初始编辑检查点与原始模型，产生600次配对评估。严格正确答案从44增加到77，技术正确答案（包括因格式被拒绝的正确最终值）从64增加到100。重复Python调用从1,834减少到1,044。在仅编辑响应技术正确的64对中，原始模型已在36对中计算出正确值但未提交技术正确的最终答案。编辑模型在64对中的13对纠正了计算。在相同50个问题上使用六个额外检查点，技术正确答案在900对中从96增加到154。我们用十个检查点各十个测试种子探索了三个选定问题。在熔解温度问题上，正确Python输出从60减少到22，而技术正确最终答案从0增加到18。权重编辑改变了Q

extra.description: Weight-space programming allows a language model to edit another model's weights without gradient-based training. We used Claude Opus 5.5 to edit Qwen3.5-0.8B and investigated how the edits changed its use of Python on computational biology problems. We compared four initial edited checkpoints with the original model on 50 test problems across three test seeds, yielding 600 paired evaluations. Strictly correct answers increased from 44 to 77, and technically correct answers, which included correct final values rejected for formatting, increased from 64 to 100. Repeated Python calls decreased from 1,834 to 1,044. Among the 64 pairs in which only the edited response was technically correct, the original model had already computed the correct value in 36 but did not submit a technically correct final answer. The edited model corrected the computation in 13 of the 64 pairs. With six additional checkpoints on the same 50 problems, technically correct answers rose from 96 to 154 across 900 pairs. We explored three selected problems with ten test seeds for each of ten checkpoints. On the melting-temperature problem, correct Python outputs decreased from 60 to 22 while technically correct final answers increased from 0 to 18. Weight editing changed both the calculations Qwen ran and whether it submitted a correct answer.

items.title: Multicellular signaling in reverse cardiac remodeling revealed by integrated bulk and single-nucleus transcriptomics
items.title_zh: 通过整合 bulk 和单核转录组学揭示逆向心脏重塑中的多细胞信号传导
items.summary_zh: 心力衰竭源于持续生物力学应力触发的适应不良多细胞重塑。尽管机械卸载可以促进逆向重塑，但恢复往往不完全，其机制基础仍不清楚。使用可逆小鼠压力超负荷模型结合 bulk 和单核转录组学，我们证明逆向重塑代表一种 actively maintained 但受限的多细胞状态。卸载改善了心脏功能并部分恢复了细胞外基质和代谢程序，而炎症和线粒体功能障碍特征持续存在。心肌细胞和内皮细胞 largely 重建了稳态转录状态，而成纤维细胞保留了主导残余病理的激活程序。多细胞因子分析描绘了一个可逆代谢应激程序和一个跨心脏细胞类型协调的持续炎症-线粒体程序。细胞-细胞通讯分析将淋巴内皮细胞识别为恢复的关键指导性调节因子。值得注意的是，淋巴衍生的 Reelin（RELN）直接抑制小鼠和人类心肌细胞中的病理性胎儿基因激活，揭示了一种以前未被认识的淋巴血管分泌机制，该机制在慢性心力衰竭中限制心肌恢复。

extra.description: Heart failure results from maladaptive multicellular remodeling triggered by sustained biomechanical stress. Although mechanical unloading can promote reverse remodeling, recovery is frequently incomplete and its mechanistic basis remains unclear. Using a reversible murine pressure-overload model combined with bulk and single-nucleus transcriptomics, we demonstrate that reverse remodeling represents an actively maintained yet constrained multicellular state. Unloading improved cardiac function and partially restored extracellular matrix and metabolic programs, whereas inflammatory and mitochondrial dysfunction signatures persisted. Cardiomyocytes and endothelial cells largely re-established homeostatic transcriptional states, while fibroblasts retained activated programs that dominated residual pathology. Multicellular factor analysis delineated a reversible metabolic stress program and a persistent inflammatory-mitochondrial program coordinated across cardiac cell types. Cell-cell communication analysis identified lymphatic endothelial cells as key instructive regulators of recovery. Notably, lymphatic-derived Reelin (RELN) directly suppressed pathological fetal gene activation in murine and human cardiomyocytes, uncovering a previously unrecognized lymphoangiocrine mechanism that constrains myocardial recovery in chronic heart failure.

items.title: CellChat Hotspot: A Targeted Approach to Cell Cell Communication Analysis With Spatial transcriptomics Validation.
items.title_zh: CellChat Hotspot：一种针对细胞-细胞通讯分析的靶向方法，具有空间转录组学验证。
items.summary_zh: 摘要。近年来，单细胞 RNA 测序（scRNA seq）通过 CellChat 等细胞-细胞通讯（CCC）工具使得研究细胞间通讯成为可能。尽管具有潜力，这些方法仍然难以解释，特别是当全局分析生成可能包含生物学无关信号的复杂相互作用网络时。为解决这一限制，我们开发了一个称为 CellChat Hotspot 的框架，旨在提高推断通讯网络的生物学可解释性。该方法将基因集富集分析与上下文驱动的过滤策略相结合，在通讯推断之前基于功能相关性选择基因和细胞。应用于 II 期结肠癌数据，CellChat Hotspot 能够识别与复发相关的条件特异性相互作用模式。非复发患者显示免疫相关过程的富集，而复发案例则以与侵袭和转移相关的通路为特征。值得注意的是，在复发患者中观察到 CALB1+ 和基质细胞之间 HSPG 通路相互作用的丧失，表明细胞基质粘附机制可能被破坏。为验证这一发现的可靠性，我们将框架应用于

extra.description: Abstract. In recent years, single cell RNA sequencing (scRNA seq) has enabled the investigation of intercellular communication through Cell Cell Communication (CCC) tools such as CellChat. Despite their potential, these approaches remain challenging to interpret, particularly when global analyses generate complex interaction networks that may include biologically irrelevant signals. To address this limitation, we developed a framework termed CellChat Hotspot, designed to improve the biological interpretability of inferred communication networks. This approach integrates gene set enrichment analysis with a context driven filtering strategy, selecting both genes and cells based on their functional relevance prior to communication inference. Applied to stage II colon cancer data, CellChat Hotspot enabled the identification of condition-specific interaction patterns associated with recurrence. Non recurrent patients showed enrichment of immune related processes, whereas recurrent cases were characterized by pathways associated with invasion and metastasis. Notably, a loss of interaction in the HSPG pathway between CALB1+ and stromal cells was observed in recurrent patients, suggesting a potential disruption of cell matrix adhesion mechanisms. To verify the reliability of this finding, we applied the framework to spatial transcriptomics data, which confirmed the presence of the HSPG2 DAG1 interaction in non-recurrent tumors and its near absence in recurrent ones. Overall, this framework provides a biologically guided strategy for studying intercellular communication in complex systems such as the tumor microenvironment.

items.title: PDO Drug Screening Data for Evaluating and Training AI Drug Response Prediction Models
items.title_zh: 用于评估和训练AI药物反应预测模型的PDO药物筛选数据
items.summary_zh: 抗癌药物反应预测（DRP）对于精准肿瘤学和治疗开发至关重要。目前，大多数DRP模型是使用永生化癌细胞系的药物筛选数据开发的，这些数据在基因组和分子水平上可能与患者肿瘤存在显著差异，尽管患者肿瘤反应是最终的预测目标。为帮助弥合这一差距并使DRP模型更接近其预期的临床应用，我们使用患者来源类器官（PDO）进行了四项药物筛选研究，PDO比永生化细胞系更忠实地再现患者肿瘤。这些研究产生了用于改进和评估DRP模型的数据，包括PDO系的多组学图谱、药物特征数据和治疗反应测量。利用这些数据，我们在三种模型构建场景下重新训练和评估了多个公开可用的DRP模型：仅使用细胞系数据训练模型、使用细胞系和PDO联合数据训练模型、以及在细胞系数据上预训练模型后在PDO数据上微调。然后我们在这些分析场景中评估和比较了模型在PDO上的预测性能。此外，我们还评估了不同实验室使用不同检测技术和/或实验方案生成的药物筛选活力数

extra.description: Anti-cancer drug response prediction (DRP) is critically important for precision oncology and therapeutic development. Currently, most DRP models are developed using drug screening data from immortalized cancer cell lines, which can differ substantially from patient tumors at the genomic and molecular levels, even though patient tumor response is the ultimate prediction target. To help bridge this gap and bring DRP models closer to their intended clinical application, we conducted four drug screening studies using patient-derived organoids (PDOs), which more faithfully recapitulate patient tumors than immortalized cell lines. These studies generated data for improving and evaluating DRP models, including multi-omics profiles of PDO lines, drug feature data, and treatment response measurements. Using these data, we retrained and evaluated multiple publicly available DRP models under three model-building scenarios: training models using cell line data only, training models using combined cell line and PDO data, and pretraining models on cell line data followed by fine-tuning on PDO data. We then evaluated and compared model prediction performance on PDOs across these analysis scenarios. In addition, we also assessed the consistency of drug screening viability data generated by different laboratories using different assay technologies and/or experimental protocols.

items.title: Synaptic Dendritic Neuron Model (scDNM) for Cell Type Classification in Single-Cell RNA Sequencing Data
items.title_zh: 突触树突神经元模型（scDNM）用于单细胞RNA测序数据中的细胞类型分类
items.summary_zh: 单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据中的细胞类型分类具有挑战性，因为存在高维度、稀疏性和转录相似的细胞类型。我们开发了scDNM，这是树突神经元模型的改编版，结合了可学习的突触阈值、监督基因池、分阶段训练和集成预测。从Paul15、PBMC3k和Nestorowa数据集构建了六个二分类任务。所有模型均使用无泄漏的嵌套交叉验证进行评估，特征选择、缩放和超参数调优独立于外部测试折进行。scDNM在六个任务中的三个中排名第一（包括一次并列），并取得了最佳平均准确率排名（2.00），其次是XGBoost（2.75）、随机森林（3.33）、逻辑回归（3.33）和SVM（3.58）。在六类PBMC3k实验中，scDNM达到了95.997%的准确率和0.944的宏F1，而SingleR为94.243%和0.914。Garnett仅返回Unknown标签，被视为零覆盖的技术结果。消融分析支持了树突和

extra.description: Cell type classification in single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data is challenging because of high dimensionality, sparsity, and transcriptionally similar cell types. We developed scDNM, an adaptation of the dendritic neuron model incorporating learnable synaptic thresholds, a supervised gene pool, staged training, and ensemble prediction. Six binary classification tasks were constructed from the Paul15, PBMC3k, and Nestorowa datasets. All models were evaluated using leakage-free nested cross-validation, with feature selection, scaling, and hyperparameter tuning performed independently of the outer test folds. scDNM ranked first in three of six tasks (including one tie) and achieved the best mean accuracy rank (2.00), followed by XGBoost (2.75), Random Forest (3.33), logistic regression (3.33), and SVM (3.58). In a six-class PBMC3k experiment, scDNM achieved 95.997% accuracy and 0.944 macro-F1, compared with 94.243% and 0.914 for SingleR. Garnett returned only Unknown labels and was treated as a zero-coverage technical outcome. Ablation analysis supported the contributions of dendrites and synaptic thresholds. However, XGBoost achieved higher mean binary-task accuracy (96.20% versus 95.32% for scDNM), and across-task rank differences were not statistically significant. These findings demonstrate that scDNM is competitive for scRNA-seq cell type classification, although broader independent validation is required.

items.title: Spool: Low-Latency Streaming Inference for Hybrid Vision-Language Models
items.title_zh: Spool：混合视觉-语言模型的低延迟流式推理
items.summary_zh: 视觉无障碍代理和机器人等应用需要及时回答关于最近视频内容的问题，在有限的历史帧窗口内（例如最近两分钟）。混合视觉-语言模型（VLM）将注意力与线性循环层如 Gated DeltaNet（GDN）交错，对此设置具有吸引力，但维护滑动窗口成本高昂。原因是循环层将所有过去帧组合成共享状态，因此过期旧帧通常需要重新运行整个窗口通过模型。我们观察到循环更新在状态中是仿射的，具有输入依赖系数，因此每帧的效果可以捕获为可结合组合的变换。我们提出 Spool，一个免训练框架，缓存每帧状态变换并在窗口推进时高效组合它们，从每个循环层的状态中移除过期帧而无需通过骨干重放帧。移除在每个层内是精确的；与注意力中的键值驱逐一样，过期帧可以通过早期层计算的缓存输入保留残余影响。我们设计了专用数据结构和 GPU 内核以实现低缓存和组合开销。在五个开源混合 VLM 和四个视频推理基准上，Spool 在所有20个模型-基准

extra.description: Applications such as visual accessibility agents and robotics require answering questions about recent video content promptly, over a bounded window of past frames (e.g., the last two minutes). Hybrid vision-language models (VLMs), which interleave attention with linear recurrent layers such as Gated DeltaNet (GDN), are attractive for this setting, but maintaining a sliding window is expensive. The reason is that recurrent layers combine all past frames into a shared state, so expiring old frames normally requires re-running the entire window through the model. We observe that the recurrent update is affine in the state with input-dependent coefficients, so the effect of each frame can be captured as a transformation that composes associatively. We present Spool, a training-free framework that caches per-frame state transformations and composes them efficiently as the window advances, removing expired frames from each recurrent layer's state without replaying frames through the backbone. Removal is exact within each layer; as with key-value eviction in attention, expired frames can retain residual influence through the cached inputs computed by earlier layers. We design a dedicated data structure and GPU kernels to achieve low caching and composition overhead. Across five open-source hybrid VLMs and four video reasoning benchmarks, Spool achieves the lowest p95 time-to-first-token in all 20 model-benchmark tests, reducing it by a geometric mean of $6.6\times$ over the faster of two recent vLLM baselines, while improving accuracy by 2.3 percentage points on average.

items.title: StringQFT: A Multiuse Textbook Resource for AI-Assisted Theoretical Physics
items.title_zh: StringQFT：一个用于 AI 辅助理论物理的多用途教科书资源
items.summary_zh: 我们呈现 StringQFT 作为量子场论弦构造的教科书集合以及 AI 辅助理论物理的基础设施。该集合包括18卷、190章和3,795页，涵盖 brane probes、brane webs、几何工程、F-理论构造、包裹 M5-branes 和精确世界面构造。其开卷基准清单包含1,073个项目，包括499个具有自动有限答案检查的项目。对于检索增强生成，它提供1,371条链接到教科书来源和 PDF 位置的章节记录，以及本地词汇检索器。训练数据准备通过21个私有的、来源链接的示例说明。对于代理，它暴露19个具有指定输入和有限域的计算工具，将工具使用与教科书推导连接。我们通过具体问题、检索段落和有限计算说明这些用途。教科书集合和 accompanying 资源可在 https://github.com/xingyang-yu/StringQFT 获取。

extra.description: We present StringQFT as a textbook collection for string constructions of quantum field theory and as infrastructure for AI-assisted theoretical physics. The collection comprises 18 volumes, 190 chapters and 3,795 pages, covering brane probes, brane webs, geometric engineering, F-theory constructions, wrapped M5-branes and exact worldsheet constructions. Its open-book benchmark inventory contains 1,073 items, including 499 with automatic finite-answer checking. For retrieval-augmented generation, it provides 1,371 section records linked to textbook sources and PDF locations, together with a local lexical retriever. Training-data preparation is illustrated by 21 private, source-linked examples. For agents, it exposes 19 calculation tools with specified inputs and finite domains, connecting tool use to textbook derivations. We illustrate these uses through specific questions, retrieved passages and finite calculations. The textbook collection and accompanying resources are available at https://github.com/xingyang-yu/StringQFT.

items.title: Do LLM Agents Still Need to Be Told How to Self-Improve?
items.title_zh: LLM 代理还需要被告知如何自我改进吗？
items.summary_zh: LLM 代理越来越多地驱动自己的学习。自我改进方法将模型优化的各种组件委托给模型本身。随着模型变得更有能力，这引发一个基本问题：这些越来越有能力的模型是否仍然需要我们指定它们应如何自我改进？在本文中，我们研究一种自主范式，其中给定基本原语、资源和自我改进的一般目标，代理构建自己的自学习算法用于基于上下文的优化。使用游戏玩法作为测试平台，一个冻结的 LLM 代理获得计算预算和用于收集经验和更新文本文档的工具，并允许自由实验，没有外部强加的循环或访问真实世界数据。我们发现足够有能力的模型在这些条件下确实自我改进，展示了与自我调节学习的经典认知框架和机器学习文献中关于自生成课程的结构一致的策略。此外，我们研究学习的文本产物转移到外部基准的程度，观察到跨不同游戏视野、机制和3D导航的改进。

extra.description: LLM agents increasingly drive their own learning. Self-improvement methods delegate various components of model optimization to the models themselves. As models become more capable, this motivates a basic question: do these increasingly capable models still need us to specify how they should self-improve? In this paper we study an autonomous paradigm in which, given basic primitives, resources, and a general goal for self-improvement, agents construct their own self-learning algorithm for context-based optimization. Using the setting of gameplay as a testbed, a frozen LLM agent is given a compute budget and tools for collecting experience and updating text documents, and allowed to freely experiment without an externally imposed loop or access to real-world data. We find that sufficiently capable models do self-improve under these conditions, demonstrating strategies that align with classic cognitive frameworks for self-regulated learning and constructs from machine learning literature on self-generated curricula. Furthermore, we study the extent to which the learned text artifacts transfer to external benchmarks, observing improvement across different game horizons, mechanics, and 3D navigation.

items.summary_zh: 11月18日，WTT官网撰文写道：王楚钦与孙颖莎是乒乓球史上最顶尖的混双组合之一。这对搭档拿到外卡，将出战2026年WTT香港总决赛这项赛季收官赛事。 2026 年 WTT 香港总决赛将于12月9日至13日在启德体育馆举办。赛事参赛资格依据选手在2026赛季积累的国际乒联世界排名积分确定：男单、女单各仅开放给世界前16名选手，混双则有7对组合凭积分入围；另外增设1张混双外卡，现已确定由王楚钦/孙颖莎获得，凑齐全部参赛阵容。 混双阵容正式出炉：王楚钦/孙颖莎、林鍾勋/申裕斌、黄镇廷/杜凯琹、雨果/高桥布鲁娜、玛纳什沙/奇塔莱、罗伯勒斯/肖瑶茜、林昀儒/郑怡静、邱党/温特。 王楚钦和孙颖莎搭档在国际赛场一共斩获 16 个冠军，其中包含 9 个 WTT 系列赛冠军、2024 巴黎奥运会金牌，以及 2025 年 WTT 香港总决赛冠军。WTT官网头条发文：史上最顶尖混双之一王楚钦/孙颖莎获得外卡，

items.title_zh: 怎么看英伟达临时CEO表示将不再向中国销售 H200 ，结束黄仁勋与特朗普促成的 25% 关税的协议？
items.summary_zh: Colette Kress 表示 Nvidia 将不再向中国销售 H200 芯片，从而结束了此前由黄仁勋与特朗普促成、允许美国收取 25% 关税的协议合作 黄仁勋刚辞职英伟达宣布H200芯片不卖中国 代理CEO证实停止销售 克雷斯表示，英伟达第3季向中国销售了价值24亿美元、经美国政府核准的Hopper系列资料中心产品。但她指出，英伟达未来的财测“并未纳入任何经核准的Hopper资料中心产品”，而且“我们已不再向中国出货经核准的Hopper资料中心产品”。 报道指，克雷斯并未进一步说明停止出货的原因。值得一提的是，就在同一天，英伟达宣布成立一个董事会级别的委员会，负责监督国家安全政策、出口管制合规性和全球贸易风险。 2026年11月17日（美国东部时间），英伟达首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯表示，英伟达将不再在中国销售H200芯片，并结束其在一项由英伟达CEO黄仁勋与特朗普斡旋促成的安排中的角色

items.title_zh: 曝 C 罗决定赛季末退役，真实性如何？为何选在那时退役？
items.summary_zh: 虎扑11月18日讯 据沙特体育记者阿卜杜勒阿齐兹-阿尔穆赖塞尔在个人社交媒体上发布的独家消息，C罗与葡萄牙足协之间的矛盾仍未得到解决。与此同时，利雅得胜利正在考虑与C罗续约一个赛季，但球员本人更倾向于在本赛季结束后退役。 该记者透露，C罗已经决定不再与佩德罗-普罗恩萨领导的现任葡萄牙足协合作，除非足协能够弥补热苏斯此前言论造成的所有问题。据悉，葡萄牙足协一名成员曾向C罗发送消息，试图与热苏斯此前针对他的言论划清界限，但C罗既没有接听相关电话，也没有回复消息。 该记者表示，热苏斯仍然在各种场合贬低C罗，而葡萄牙足协对此始终保持沉默。C罗也拒绝接受足协就相关言论给出的解释，并通过一名中间人传达了自己的态度。他认为，葡萄牙足协此前为他采取的措施远远不够，自己理应得到更多。 在职业生涯规划方面，利雅得胜利目前存在与C罗续约一年的设想，但C罗本人更倾向于在2026-27赛季结束后退役。C罗准备在未来

items.title: 英伟达史上首次单季营收突破千亿美元，数据中心收入占比约九成，AI 算力需求还能支撑英伟达增长多久？
items.title_zh: 英伟达史上首次单季营收突破千亿美元，数据中心收入占比约九成，AI 算力需求还能支撑英伟达增长多久？
items.summary_zh: 每经快讯，当地时间11月17日美股盘后，英伟达公布了最新财报，截至2026年10月25日的公司2027财年第三财季，公司营收同比增长103.1%至1158亿美元，这不但是公司史上首次单季营收突破1000亿美元，而且较分析师预期高约5.9%，也明显高于该司自身指引中值1080亿美元。非GAAP口径下，英伟达第三财季净利润648.7亿美元，同比增长109%，环比增长20%；调整后EPS为2.68美元，同比增长111%，环比增长21%。第三财季非GAAP口径下调整后每股收益（EPS）同比增长111%至2.68美元，较市场预期高8.1%。第三财季数据中心收入保持翻倍增长至1076亿美元，较市场预期高5.6%，继续约占公司总营收九成。此外，公司预计第四季度营收1261亿至1339亿美元，同样高于市场预期。英伟达在财报中宣布，董事会已于2026年9月批准将股票回购授权增加1500亿美元，且没有到期日。

items.title: 如何看待雷军 APEC 发言紧张，网友称「好像略微有点社恐」？
items.title_zh: 如何看待雷军 APEC 发言紧张，网友称「好像略微有点社恐」？
items.summary_zh: 11月17日，雷军晒出APEC发言图，并配文“APEC CEO Summit 2026！”雷军在评论区写道“给台下朋友们拍了一张合影 ”。 评论区里，有粉丝问道，“全程看完雷总发言，好像略微有点社恐”，随后小米服务 在评论区解释道“这么大的国际场合，紧张太正常啦”。 据中新网，11月17日，小米集团创始人、董事长兼CEO雷军在2026年亚太经合组织(APEC)工商领导人峰会上表示，具身智能机器人肯定是一个巨大的产业机会，它的想象力会超过汽车产业。小米特别看好AI走向物理世界以后带来的空间和想象力，这给整个亚太经济会带来巨大的机会。小米回应雷军APEC发言紧张：这么大的国际场合，紧张太正常啦

items.title: 为什么近期国产3A动作游戏（《黑神话：悟空》《明末：渊虚之羽》《影之刃零》）普遍走暗黑压抑风格？
items.title_zh: 为什么近期国产3A动作游戏（《黑神话：悟空》《明末：渊虚之羽》《影之刃零》）普遍走暗黑压抑风格？
items.summary_zh: 我注意到，近期几款备受关注的国产3A/买断制动作游戏，在美术和世界观上都偏向暗黑、压抑、破败的风格，比如《黑神话：悟空》《明末：渊虚之羽》和《影之刃零》。想请教大家：这是否与类魂玩法、写实引擎表现、市场验证过的“安全模板”有关？暗黑风格在开发上是否更“省力”——比如更容易掩盖贴图/模型瑕疵、省去大量明亮场景所需的生态和NPC建设？如果国产团队想做积极阳光、明亮开阔的高规格3A动作游戏，主要难点在美术工业化、叙事冲突设计，还是商业风险？这种“暗黑扎堆”是国产3A初期的阶段性现象，还是动作游戏品类本身的必然倾向？ 希望从游戏设计、工业化和市场策略角度聊聊，不引战，单纯讨论风格选择背后的原因。

items.title: 女子在盒马下单四百多次全部申请仅退款，称「刺激解压」，明知不光彩还是忍不住下单，如何从心理学角度解读？
items.title_zh: 女子在盒马下单四百多次全部申请仅退款，称「刺激解压」，明知不光彩还是忍不住下单，如何从心理学角度解读？
items.summary_zh: 几十元的零食，她下了 400 多次单；三年下来，如此多订单一分钱没花，家里的盒马零食却堆得到处都是。近日，西安公安经开分局张家堡派出所破获一起利用电商平台「仅退款」规则实施诈骗的案件，29 岁的涉案女子被依法刑事拘留，涉案金额 1.7 万余元。 据办案民警齐熠男介绍，该女子长期在家备考研究生，年复一年，成绩总差那么一口气，人也越来越郁闷。2023 年的一天，她下单买了一批零食，收货后随手点开售后页面，发现只要选择一个特定理由，就能申请「仅退款」——钱退回来，货也不用寄回，据该女子供述：这让她感到「刺激」，能够舒缓压力。 三年时间，400 多单，平均不到三天就有一单，商品从零食、饮料到日用品，几乎覆盖了日常所需。 目前，该女子已被经开公安张家堡派出所依法刑事拘留，案件正在进一步侦办中。 来源：红星新闻

items.summary_zh: 2026年APEC领导人会议周多场会议活动今天继续进行。今天，APEC工商领导人峰会进入第二天，上午举行了开幕式，APEC第三十三次领导人非正式会议也在深圳举行。 APEC领导人会议周新闻中心场馆中人潮涌动，这里的公共工作区内几乎座无虚席，这也表明今天的两场重要会议备受瞩目。 · APEC工商领导人峰会看点不断 亚太政商领袖共话合作新机遇 昨天，2026年APEC工商领导人峰会在前海开幕，今天进入第二天。本次峰会覆盖21个APEC经济体，吸引来自英国、法国、德国等13个域外经济体的企业代表，2000余位政商人士参会。各方聚焦“亚太经济新图景与合作新机遇”，议题包括共建开放普惠的人工智能创新生态、探索亚太数字经济合作新路径等，回应新一轮科技变革带来的产业机遇。 峰会进程过半，今天继续凝聚共识。最大看点是会后将发布《2026年APEC工商领导人峰会深圳倡议》——这是峰会创办30年来首次以倡议形

items.title: 7 吨级大型运投无人机「长鹰-8」圆满完成运输投送试验，如何看待这次突破？它会带来哪些改变？
items.title_zh: 7 吨级大型运投无人机「长鹰-8」圆满完成运输投送试验，如何看待这次突破？它会带来哪些改变？
items.summary_zh: 记者今天（17日）从中国兵器工业集团获悉，近日，我国自主研制的7吨级大型运投无人机“长鹰-8”圆满完成运输投送试验。无人机按预定航线平稳起飞，抵达投放区域后于300米高度实施空投，货盘按指令自动出舱、伞花精准绽开，随后安全返航、平稳降落。 试验依次完成装载检查、航线装订、起飞爬升、空中巡航、舱门开启、自动投放、伞绳回收、返航降落及落点评估等环节。地面控制站全程监控飞行状态与投放流程，各系统工作稳定、数据链路通畅。试验重点检验了货盘模块化装载、300米高度投放、自动出舱时序控制、伞绳回收及落点评估等关键能力。 “长鹰-8”长17米，翼展达到25米，18立方米超大容积的货舱能兼容多型标准航空集装箱与专业冷链运储箱，并且在15分钟内就可以完成装卸，大幅提升物流周转效率。同时，“长鹰-8”起飞重量达到7吨，载重能力3.5吨，最大航程超过3000公里，具备高原起降和最短200米的短距起降能力，可以适

items.title: 工信部严抓 60 天账期落地，17 家车企被要求定期报送数据，该举措对保障供应链回款作用有多大？
items.title_zh: 工信部严抓 60 天账期落地，17 家车企被要求定期报送数据，该举措对保障供应链回款作用有多大？
items.summary_zh: 车企供应商账期问题再次成为焦点。 11月16日，中国汽车工业协会发布《关于开展汽车企业供应商账款支付调研评估工作的通知》（下称《通知》），针对包括一汽、东风、长安、北汽、广汽、比亚迪、蔚来等17家重点车企，开展供应商账款支付情况调研评估。 具体的评估内容包括四点：一是制度保障机制，汽车企业是否建立明确、有效的账款支付管理制度和数字化系统;是否与供应商建立长期稳定的合作关系，每次签订供货合同的有效期不少于一年; 二是中小企业账款支付情况，账期天数是否不超过60天;是否全部采用现金(银行转账、电汇等)支付;是否全部采用现金和银行承兑汇票支付; 三是非中小企业账款支付情况，账期天数是否在《关于推动汽车企业规范供应商账款支付优化账期管理的通知》规定的60天内;账期天数是否符合2025年9月15日中国汽车工业协会发布的《汽车整车企业供应商账款支付规范倡议》规定的60天内;现金和银行承兑汇票支付比例是

items.title: 网传生菜「塌房」了，看似健康其实膳食纤维的含量很低，是真的吗？
items.title_zh: 网传生菜「塌房」了，看似健康其实膳食纤维的含量很低，是真的吗？
items.summary_zh: 网上有人在说最近发现生菜的膳食纤维含量极低，95% 都是水，想靠吃生菜凑够一天所需的 25 克膳食纤维得吃上 7 斤。 很多打工人天天在工位生啃生菜、吃全是生菜的沙拉，嚼得腮帮子酸也没帮上肠道蠕动的忙。 这是真的吗？那如果想要补充足够的膳食纤维，有什么报恩蔬菜推荐呢？https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/t-xeeBQS2DD3aINlgIr2OQ

items.title: 辛顿称AI比所有数学家都聪明，10年内将发展出人类无法理解的数学分支，如何评价AI取代数学家的现象？
items.title_zh: 辛顿称AI比所有数学家都聪明，10年内将发展出人类无法理解的数学分支，如何评价AI取代数学家的现象？
items.summary_zh: 当地时间11月14日，诺奖得主、“人工智能教父”辛顿表示，AI在数学上已比几乎所有数学家都更聪明；多数数学家都判断，未来几年、很可能10年内，AI将发展出人类根本无法理解的数学分支。（澎湃新闻）

items.title: 业内人士称不建议买500元以下羽绒服，基本不合格，500元真是羽绒服的分水岭吗？选购时应留心哪些标准？
items.title_zh: 业内人士称不建议买500元以下羽绒服，基本不合格，500元真是羽绒服的分水岭吗？选购时应留心哪些标准？
items.summary_zh: 【羽绒服从业者：#500元以下很难买到真羽绒服# 高绒子含量羽绒服成本要好几百】#怎么靠手感辨别羽绒服好坏#11月9日报道，河南郑州一家羽绒服翻新定做店，店长胡先生表示，在非反季的正常情况下，五百元以下很难买到真羽绒服。他提到，绒子含量80%、90%以上的羽绒服，光成本就得好几百元。“去店里买，首先是一摸，里面比较柔软，它没有那种滑溜的感觉，它基本上都是羽绒的。另外就是回弹，一抓它自己慢慢回弹起来。”店长称非专业人士仅靠手摸很难辨别真假绒，建议去正规店看水洗标购买，别贪小便宜。（原创 编辑言言） 羽绒服从业者：500元以下很难买到真羽绒服 高绒子含量羽绒服成本要好几百|反季|绒子|羽绒服_手机网易网羽绒服从业者：500元以下很难买到真羽绒服 高绒子含量羽绒服成本要好几百_手机网易网
